items.en: «8-й НПЗ под ударом» (Rybar: '8th refinery under attack') — Kirishi refinery hit amid one of the largest drone raids on Leningrad Oblast, with 113 drones reportedly downed

items.sEn: According to Rybar, Ukraine's November campaign against Russian oil refineries is continuing: during the night of 9 November the refinery in Kirishi, Leningrad Oblast, one of the largest in Russia, was hit; the channel counts it as the eighth refinery struck. Governor Aleksandr Drozdenko reportedly confirmed the hit.…

Gouverneur Aleksandr Drozdenko zou de inslag…
